notes:
Summary: Mid-market product analytics SaaS. Evaluating Hosted API first for speed of integration, then want Dedicated for predictable unit economics and tenant isolation. Very cost sensitive — VP Product wants committed pricing that drops per-token cost by >=40% vs hosted list when on Dedicated.

POC/Technical highlights: 
- Primary workloads: chat assistant for agents (multi-turn, avg 120 tokens), doc search/embedding rerank for KB (short vectors), occasional batch summarization jobs (longer sequences).
- Latency SLOs: interactive chat p95 target 100-150ms for single-turn fast-path; willing to accept higher p95 for long summarization jobs.
- Throughput: need sustained 150-250 reqs/s during peak for agent routing; burst to 400 for flash sales events.
- Cost targets: want per-1000-token effective cost <= $0.08 for chat (including infra overhead) after batching + KV cache; current hosted baseline ~$0.22/1k tokens.
- Security: must support SSO/SAML, audit logs + KMS; data residency for EU customers is a hard requirement.

Workshop takeaways (1/28):
- Batching: good wins for chat when client-side aggregator groups short messages; recommended batching window 8-12ms for avg latency tradeoff. Expected 20-35% token cost reduction from batching for chat.
- KV/Prefix caching: heavy repeat prefix patterns in agent prompts — caching can save ~25% token compute for common flows. Need instrumentation to measure prefix reuse rate in POC.
- Quantization: SE recommended mixed strategy — 4-bit quant for candidate rerank models; maintain fp16 for final chat model to preserve quality. Simulation shows ~30% GPU cost reduction on reranking workloads with negligible quality loss.
- Unit economics model: Redwood shared worksheet; modeled unit cost sensitivity to batch size, seq length, and cache hit rate. Key lever is improving cache hit > 40% and batching efficiency > 60% for chat.

Quotes / notes from stakeholders:
- "Predictability beats raw lowest-cost — we need to forecast monthly spend for leadership" — VP Product (Elena Marcano).
